question.text: A battery of emf $\mathrm{E}$ and internal resistance $\mathrm{r}$ is connected with an external resistance $\mathrm{R}$ as shown in the figure. The battery will act as a constant voltage source if

options.text: It will never act as a constant voltage source

solution.text: $V_R=\frac{E}{(R+r)} \times R, \quad V_R=\frac{E}{(1+r / R)}$ $r < R, V_R \approx E$
